source: Existing CPU-verified 3B audit and sealed uploaded traces; diagnostic inspection, no new GPU inference

adult_col_005.request: Add a column is_married: 'Married' for Married-civ-spouse, Married-spouse-absent and Married-AF-spouse, and 'Not married' for everyone else.
adult_col_005.diagnosis: Map encodes an "Other" key as if it were a default. The contract does not represent the requested fallback for every unmatched marital-status value.

adult_conv_003.request: Make education an ordered category that follows the education-num order, from Preschool (lowest) to Doctorate (highest).
adult_conv_003.diagnosis: Selective: invalid JSON contains an ellipsis in the category list. Tools: invented education labels and a mismatched mapping from education-num. Needs input-derived category/rank pairs and explicit ordered-category semantics.

adult_dedup_003.request: fnlwgt should identify a record, so remove repeated fnlwgt values and keep the first record for each.
adult_dedup_003.diagnosis: Usable contract. Initial merge raises KeyError; repair inspects nonexistent last_output and keeps complicating the merge/helper-column approach. A fresh formulation should preserve original records and deduplicate on fnlwgt.

adult_filt_004.request: Remove the people whose education level is Preschool or 1st-4th.
adult_filt_004.diagnosis: Both contracts compare the categorical education strings with numeric thresholds; verification is uncertain. The request names two string categories.

adult_filt_005.request: Remove self-employed people (incorporated or not) who are older than 60.
adult_filt_005.diagnosis: Selective binds self-employment to education=Private instead of workclass categories. Tools emits a predicate name as an unavailable tool and never produces a usable contract.

tools.parser_error: invalid contract: tool: Extra inputs are not permitted; args: Extra inputs are not permitted; target: Extra inputs are not permitted; op: Extra inputs are not permitted

adult_miss_005.request: People with no workclass and no occupation listed are not working. Fill both missing workclass and missing occupation with 'Not-working'.
adult_miss_005.diagnosis: Initially correct code is withheld. Filling null cells conflicts with preserving null count; tools additionally preserves the edited cell values. Resolve the contract, not the code alone.

airbnb_conv_005.request: Make room_type an ordered category, from smallest to largest: Shared room, then Private room, then Entire home/apt.
airbnb_conv_005.diagnosis: Usable contract. set_categories result is discarded; ordered=False remains. The repair agent repeats the same code despite an explicit ordered-flag failure.

airbnb_dedup_001.request: Some listings share exactly the same name. Treat those as duplicates and keep only the first one.
airbnb_dedup_001.diagnosis: Initially correct code is withheld because the contract deduplicates all columns instead of listing name.

airbnb_dedup_002.request: Remove listings where the same host has posted the same listing name more than once; keep the first copy.
airbnb_dedup_002.diagnosis: Initially correct code is withheld; contract uses nonexistent listing_name and the wrong host identity field. Need exact input schema and request-to-key binding.

airbnb_dedup_003.request: Keep only one listing per host: the first one that appears in the data.
airbnb_dedup_003.diagnosis: Selective withholds initially correct code because the contract uses all columns rather than host_id. Tools succeeds.

airbnb_dedup_004.request: For each host, keep just one listing per room type, using the last one that appears.
airbnb_dedup_004.diagnosis: Selective omits host_id from the composite key. Tools has a reference-compatible contract but filters to groups of size one before keeping last, deleting all repeated groups. Adding a sort does not restore the lost groups.

airbnb_filt_002.request: I only want to keep listings located in Brooklyn and Manhattan.
airbnb_filt_002.diagnosis: Both incorrectly accept an empty output. Contract selects neighbourhood instead of the borough-valued neighbourhood_group; correct reference has 927 rows. Relevant categorical-value evidence is missing.

taxi_col_004.diagnosis: Usable contract under the current NumPy rounding convention. Scalar Python round(x,1) differs from pandas/NumPy round on 42 input rows; retries keep using scalar round.

taxi_col_005.request: Add a column fare_per_mile equal to fare_amount divided by trip_distance. For trips with a distance of 0 the value should be missing.
taxi_col_005.diagnosis: Selective contract attempts to preserve values of a newly added column that does not exist in the input. Tools succeeds. Zero-distance behavior must also remain represented.

taxi_dedup_005.request: Keep only the first trip for each combination of pickup zone (PULocationID) and dropoff zone (DOLocationID).
taxi_dedup_005.diagnosis: Usable contract. Sorting by pickup timestamp before deduplication changes which original row is first; 99 key groups retain the wrong record. Repeated proposals preserve this error.

taxi_filt_004.request: Remove the trips that were picked up before 1 January 2026. The pickup and dropoff times are text in the form YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (for example 2026-01-01 00:54:04).
taxi_filt_004.diagnosis: Both incorrectly accept the result with an extra pickup_datetime helper column. Existing columns_unchanged does not forbid extra output columns; both gold and predicted contracts pass the wrong output.

taxi_miss_005.request: In this file a passenger_count of 0 and a RatecodeID of 99 both mean 'not recorded'. Mark those values as missing.
taxi_miss_005.diagnosis: Selective router mistakes ordinary "mean" (signify) for a statistic and stops before parsing. Tools succeeds.

selective.parser_error: Conditional statistic needs an explicit column = value scope

titanic_col_001.request: Add a column num_relatives with the number of relatives aboard: SibSp plus Parch.
titanic_col_001.diagnosis: Usable contract. Code adds num_relatives but removes SibSp/Parch (and sometimes more columns); repeated repair fails to preserve inputs.

titanic_col_003.diagnosis: Usable contract under current NumPy rounding convention. Scalar Python round(x,2) differs from pandas/NumPy round on 29 rows; repeated proposals preserve the discrepancy.

titanic_col_005.request: Cap Fare at 200 (higher fares become 200) and raise every Age below 1 to 1. Missing ages stay missing.
titanic_col_005.diagnosis: Selective encodes a threshold with a literal map key "<1"; tools multiplies Age by one instead of setting ages below one to one. Tools initially has correct code and loses it.

titanic_conv_002.request: Make Pclass an ordered categorical column where third class (3) is the lowest and first class (1) is the highest.
titanic_conv_002.diagnosis: Selective emits invalid map arguments. Tools emits the wrong category order [1,3,2] and a spurious remapping. Request needs category order [3,2,1] with original values retained.

selective.parser_error: invalid contract: must_change.1.column_value_relation.args.0.ColArg.from: Extra inputs are not permitted; must_change.1.column_value_relation.args.0.ColArg.to: Extra inputs are not permitted; must_change.1.column_value_relation.args.0.LitArg.col: Extra inputs are not permitted; must_change.1.column_value_relation.args.0.LitArg.from: Extra inputs are not permitted; must_change.1.column_value_relation.args.0.LitArg.to: Extra inputs are not permitted

titanic_conv_003.request: Convert Survived to a boolean column: True for 1 and False for 0.
titanic_conv_003.diagnosis: Both withhold initially correct code. Contract mapping uses string keys True/False rather than the input values 1/0 under current typed mapping semantics.

titanic_dedup_002.request: Passengers who share the same ticket number are duplicates. Keep only the last passenger listed for each ticket.
titanic_dedup_002.diagnosis: Usable contract. Sorting Ticket before keeping last changes original record order/tie selection; repair repeats the initial program.

titanic_dedup_004.request: Keep only one passenger for each combination of class and sex: the first one listed.
titanic_dedup_004.diagnosis: Usable contract. Invalid groupby keep argument is followed by groupby.first(), which can aggregate first nonmissing values instead of retaining one complete original record.

titanic_filt_003.request: Remove passengers younger than 18. Passengers whose age is unknown should stay.
titanic_filt_003.diagnosis: Usable contract. Code drops unknown ages although request preserves them; the final failure report identifies 177 missing rows that should stay.

titanic_filt_005.request: Keep only the passengers who travelled alone, with no siblings, spouses, parents or children aboard.
titanic_filt_005.diagnosis: Selective emits invalid null operator; both contracts invent Cabin/Fare conditions unrelated to travelling alone. Tools initially has correct code but is withheld.

selective.parser_error: invalid contract: must_preserve.0.rows_retained_where.condition.all.2.op: Input should be '==', '!=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=', 'in', 'not_in', 'is_null' or 'not_null'

titanic_miss_005.request: Fill each missing Age with the median age of passengers in the same class (Pclass).
titanic_miss_005.diagnosis: Selective cannot compute grouped statistics in its current facts router. Tools queries Pclass rather than Age grouped by Pclass and fills with 3. Existing group_profile can retrieve the required values but was not selected.

selective.parser_error: Conditional statistic needs an explicit column = value scope

taxi_conv_002.request: Convert both tpep_pickup_datetime and tpep_dropoff_datetime into proper datetime columns. The pickup and dropoff times are text in the form YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (for example 2026-01-01 00:54:04).
taxi_conv_002.diagnosis: Tools withholds initially correct code: it requires timestamp conversion while preserving the original string values under the current verifier semantics. Selective succeeds.

taxi_miss_003.request: A passenger_count of 0 means it was not recorded. Replace those values with 1.
taxi_miss_003.diagnosis: Tools withholds initially correct code: replacing zero with one conflicts with a required increase in null count while the remaining cells are preserved. Selective succeeds.

taxi_miss_004.request: RatecodeID 99 means the rate code is unknown. Assume the standard rate and replace those values with 1.
taxi_miss_004.diagnosis: Tools withholds initially correct code: replacing 99 with one conflicts with a required increase in null count. Selective succeeds.
